segments.ja497:1.1: Kuto nu āgacchasi dummavāsī [rummavāsī (sī. pī.)], otallako paṃsupisācakova;
segments.ja497:1.3: Saṅkāracoḷaṃ paṭimuñca [paṭimucca (sī. pī.)] kaṇṭhe, ko re tuvaṃ hosi [hohisi (sī. pī.)] adakkhiṇeyyo.
segments.ja497:2.1: Annaṃ tavedaṃ [tava idaṃ (ka. sī. pī.), tavayidaṃ (syā.)] pakataṃ yasassi, taṃ khajjare bhuñjare piyyare ca;
segments.ja497:2.3: Jānāsi maṃ tvaṃ paradattūpajīviṃ, uttiṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ labhataṃ sapāko.
segments.ja497:3.1: Annaṃ mamedaṃ [mama idaṃ (ka. sī. pī.), mamayidaṃ (syā.)] pakataṃ brāhmaṇānaṃ, attatthāya saddahato mamedaṃ [mama idaṃ (ka. sī. pī.), mamayidaṃ (syā.)];
segments.ja497:3.3: Apehi etto kimidhaṭṭhitosi, na mādisā tuyhaṃ dadanti jamma.
segments.ja497:4.1: Thale ca ninne ca vapanti bījaṃ, anūpakhette phalamāsamānā [māsasānā (sī. pī.), māsiṃ samānā (syā.)];
segments.ja497:4.3: Etāya saddhāya dadāhi dānaṃ, appeva ārādhaye dakkhiṇeyye.
segments.ja497:5.1: Khettāni mayhaṃ viditāni loke, yesāhaṃ bījāni patiṭṭhapemi;
segments.ja497:5.3: Ye brāhmaṇā jātimantūpapannā, tānīdha khettāni supesalāni.
segments.ja497:6.1: Jātimado ca atimānitā ca, lobho ca doso ca mado ca moho;
segments.ja497:6.3: Ete aguṇā yesu ca santi [yesu vasanti (sī. pī.)] sabbe, tānīdha khettāni apesalāni.
segments.ja497:7.1: Jātimado ca atimānitā ca, lobho ca doso ca mado ca moho;
segments.ja497:7.3: Ete aguṇā yesu na santi sabbe, tānīdha khettāni supesalāni.
segments.ja497:8.1: Kvettha gatā [kvattha gatā (syā.), kattheva bhaṭṭhā (pī.)] upajotiyo ca, upajjhāyo ca athavā gaṇḍakucchi [aṇḍakucchi (sī. syā. pī.)];
segments.ja497:8.3: Imassa daṇḍañca vadhañca datvā, gale gahetvā khalayātha [galayātha (ka.)] jammaṃ.
segments.ja497:9.1: Giriṃ nakhena khaṇasi, ayo dantehi [dantena (sī. pī.)] khādasi;
segments.ja497:11.1: Āvellitaṃ [aveṭhitaṃ (sī. pī.)] piṭṭhito uttamaṅgaṃ, bāhuṃ [bāhaṃ (sī. pī.)] pasāreti akammaneyyaṃ [akampaneyyaṃ (ka.)];
segments.ja497:11.3: Setāni akkhīni yathā matassa, ko me imaṃ puttamakāsi evaṃ.
segments.ja497:12.3: Saṅkāracoḷaṃ paṭimuñca kaṇṭhe, so te imaṃ puttamakāsi evaṃ.
segments.ja497:13.1: Katamaṃ disaṃ agamā bhūripañño, akkhātha me māṇavā etamatthaṃ;
segments.ja497:13.3: Gantvāna taṃ paṭikaremu accayaṃ, appeva naṃ putta labhemu jīvitaṃ.
segments.ja497:14.1: Vehāyasaṃ agamā bhūripañño, pathaddhuno pannaraseva cando;
segments.ja497:14.3: Api cāpi so purimadisaṃ agacchi, saccappaṭiñño isi sādhurūpo.
segments.ja497:15.1: Āvellitaṃ piṭṭhito uttamaṅgaṃ, bāhuṃ pasāreti akammaneyyaṃ;
segments.ja497:15.3: Setāni akkhīni yathā matassa, ko me imaṃ puttamakāsi evaṃ.
segments.ja497:16.1: Yakkhā have santi mahānubhāvā, anvāgatā isayo sādhurūpā;
segments.ja497:16.3: Te duṭṭhacittaṃ kupitaṃ viditvā, yakkhā hi te puttamakaṃsu evaṃ.
segments.ja497:17.1: Yakkhā ca me puttamakaṃsu evaṃ, tvaññeva me mā kuddho [kuddha (ka.)] brahmacāri;
segments.ja497:17.3: Tumheva [tuyheva (ka.)] pāde saraṇaṃ gatāsmi, anvāgatā puttasokena bhikkhu.
segments.ja497:18.1: Tadeva hi etarahi ca mayhaṃ, manopadoso na mamatthi [mama natthi (pī.)] koci;
segments.ja497:18.3: Putto ca te vedamadena matto, atthaṃ na jānāti adhicca vede.
segments.ja497:19.1: Addhā have bhikkhu muhuttakena, sammuyhateva purisassa saññā;
segments.ja497:19.3: Ekāparādhaṃ [etāparādhaṃ (ka.)] khama bhūripañña, na paṇḍitā kodhabalā bhavanti.
segments.ja497:20.1: Idañca mayhaṃ uttiṭṭhapiṇḍaṃ, tava [natthi sī. pī. potthakesu] maṇḍabyo bhuñjatu appapañño;
segments.ja497:20.3: Yakkhā ca te naṃ [te puttaṃ (syā.)] na viheṭhayeyyuṃ, putto ca te hessati [hohiti (sī. pī.)] so arogo.
segments.ja497:22.1: Jaṭā ca kesā ajinā nivatthā, jarūdapānaṃva mukhaṃ parūḷhaṃ;
segments.ja497:22.3: Pajaṃ imaṃ passatha dummarūpaṃ [rummarūpiṃ (sī. pī.)], na jaṭājinaṃ tāyati appapaññaṃ.
segments.ja497:23.1: Yesaṃ rāgo ca doso ca, avijjā ca virājitā;
